title: One month coding with GLM 5.3 Flash
summary: A Wagtail developer shares their practical experience using GLM 5.3 Flash (Zhipu AI's large language model) for coding tasks over one month, providing real-world feedback on its capabilities and limitations for software development work.
problem_solved: Evaluates whether GLM 5.3 Flash is a viable alternative to other AI coding assistants for real-world development projects.
why_valuable: Provides honest, hands-on experience report from an actual developer using a Chinese LLM for production coding work, offering practical insights rather than just benchmarks.
